input.quote: the Approval Payments will be multiplied by a fraction, the numerator of which is such actual amount of Development Costs paid or incurred by SFJ hereunder (as adjusted, to the extent applicable, pursuant to Section 2.3.3, Section 3.12.2 and/or Section 3.12.3) and the denominator of which is One Hundred Twenty Million U.S. Dollars ($120,000,000.00).
input.rationale: No take-or-pay or minimum purchase commitment is imposed on PB. Our payments to SFJ (Article 6) are consideration for the Trial Data Package and arise only if and when Regulatory Approval is obtained, they scale strictly pro rata to the Development Costs SFJ actually pays or incurs under Section 6.2 (an express true-up, including refunds/adjustments and relief if conditional approval is withdrawn), and PB may extinguish them through the Approval or Change of Control Buy-Out Options in Section 6.7. PB also has an at-will exit under Section 14.2.2 before first Regulatory Approval, so this is not a locked multi-year commitment. Two sub-elements are worth noting but are not material deviations: (i) Section 4.2.3(ii) requires PB's Elected Total Amount to be "no less than $110 million and no more than $120 million", which is a minimum draw of SFJ funding rather than a purchase obligation, and the resulting liability remains success-contingent and proportionate; and (ii) the last sentence of Section 4.2.3 requires PB to spend at least the amount SFJ funds, which operates as a use-of-proceeds/diligence covenant satisfied out of SFJ's own funding, not incremental spend on us. The buy-out and 300% termination economics are addressed under the termination/liquidated damages rules and are not double-flagged here. Overall the structure sits at or above the fallback (usage/success-based fees with a true-up rather than a shortfall penalty), so no redline.
